flags.trained_on: all patients (the cross-validated numbers come from oof_*.csv, not from this model)
flags.note: binary transitional-anatomy flag: reports 'count the whole spine / check the CT'. It never assigns a Castellvi type or a level name.
flags.pooling: mean over a patient's evaluable renders
flags.caveat: cross-validated on synthetic renders of 802 CT records from one dataset; 125 positive patients. Not validated on real radiographs.
flags.do_not_pool_cohorts: a single AUC over cohorts with 4% and 46% positive rates measures which dataset a render came from, not transitional anatomy
